decisions.reason: Because it remains close to the core decorative assortment and the firm values breadth, management would still tend to interpret any modest performance as temporary despite its relatively low public commitment.
Its dedicated web presence, flame-retardant functionality and strong fit with the firm's contract-curtain business make management especially reluctant to reverse course.

With only limited visible commitment, a more niche position, and a wool-blend profile that fits less neatly with the firm's stated move away from hard-to-recycle blends, this has become the easiest product to prune.
Although specialized and not heavily publicized, it still extends the firm's design-led collection logic and can be defended as needing more time to find its market.
As the newest launch and one given its own page, it benefits from fresh investment and visible commitment, so management is likely to persist rather than admit failure quickly.
